title: F0 finance stretch — decisions required before build
why_deferred: No VAT rate/settings, no bank_* schema, and EPS/online money today posts to wallet/order paid — not a bank SoT. Half-building a MiddoBankLedger or VAT-from-guessed-totals would invent finance truth.
invariants: Do not invent a Middo login user
Cash till and bank float stay distinct until product defines cash↔bank posts

today.eps_online: CorporateWalletTopUp / order amount_paid — no bank mirror
today.accounts_a4: Operating costs + money buckets + order flow (not period P&L / bank / VAT)

decisions_before_code.ask: Statutory VAT/tax rate(s)? Inclusive vs exclusive? On food vs charges? Effective date? Stored per order line vs report-time compute?
One Middo bank float vs multi-account? What posts: EPS paid sessions, wallet top-ups, cash→bank deposits, partner payouts from bank?
Does till deposit debit MiddoCashLedger and credit bank (double-entry)? Who may post (accounts|admin)?
Kitchen/rider withdrawals stay Middo cash debit, or move to bank when bank SoT exists?
Period P&L / kitchen settlement batches in F0 or a later F2?
Who mandates (finance/audit), and what filing or export is required?

ship_only_after: All of vat + bank_sot + cash_bank answered; then 1–2 surfaces max (e.g. MiddoBankLedger + VAT report).
